content.json:
## Delinea Platform — User Activity Investigation

Select a user to review their full activity across the Delinea Platform (`DelineaAuditEvents_CL`): authentication, secret access, source IPs and event timeline. Use this during incident response to answer "what did this account do?".

parameters.name: User
parameters.label: User
parameters.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend Actor = tostring(parse_json(RawData).actor.name) | where isnotempty(Actor) | distinct Actor | sort by Actor asc

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress) | where Actor == '{User}' | summarize TotalEvents = count(), DistinctSecrets = dcount(SecretId), SourceIPs = dcount(SourceIP), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) | project Metrics = pack_array('Total events', 'Distinct secrets', 'Source IPs', 'First seen', 'Last seen'), Values = pack_array(tostring(TotalEvents), tostring(DistinctSecrets), tostring(SourceIPs), tostring(FirstSeen), tostring(LastSeen)) | mv-expand Metric = Metrics to typeof(string), Value = Values to typeof(string) | project Metric, Value
content.title: Activity summary for {User}

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type) | where Actor == '{User}' | summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ServiceType
content.title: Activity timeline by service

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name) | where Actor == '{User}' | summarize Count = count() by EventName | sort by Count desc
content.title: Event types

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name) | where Actor == '{User}' and (ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault') and isnotempty(SecretId) | summarize Accesses = count(), LastAccess = max(TimeGenerated) by Secret = SecretId | sort by Accesses desc
content.title: Secrets accessed by {User}

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress), OS = tostring(d.source.host.client.operatingSystem) | where Actor == '{User}' and isnotempty(SourceIP) | summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), OperatingSystems = make_set(OS, 10) by SourceIP | sort by Events desc
content.title: Source IP addresses used by {User}

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), attrs = d.additionalAttributes | where Actor == '{User}' and EventName has 'MfaAuthentication' | extend MfaResult = tostring(attrs.MfaResult[0]), Factors = tostring(attrs.Factors[0]), Reason = tostring(attrs.FailReason[0]) | project TimeGenerated, MfaResult, Factors, FailReason = Reason | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 100
content.title: MFA history for {User}

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress), Message = tostring(d.displayMessage) | where Actor == '{User}' | project TimeGenerated, EventName, Level, Message, SourceIP, Secret = SecretId | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 250
content.title: Raw event timeline for {User}
